info.name: Get code-block variant for a user

params.name: user-id
params.description: The Apptimize user (customer) identifier the assignment is scoped to.

params.name: code-block-variable-name
params.description: The name of the code-block variable defined in Apptimize.

params.name: attributes
params.description: JSON object of custom user attributes used for experiment targeting, passed as query parameters on GET requests.

items.docs: Returns which code-block variant is assigned to the given user for the named code-block variable, based on the user's experiment participation.

info.name: Get dynamic-variable value for a user

params.name: user-id
params.description: The Apptimize user (customer) identifier the assignment is scoped to.

params.name: type
params.description: The declared type of the dynamic variable (e.g. string, integer, boolean, double, array, dictionary).

params.name: dynamic-variable-name
params.description: The name of the dynamic variable defined in Apptimize.

params.name: attributes
params.description: JSON object of custom user attributes used for experiment targeting, passed as query parameters on GET requests.

items.docs: Returns the value of the named dynamic variable for the given user, resolving any experiment variant the user is enrolled in. The type path segment declares the expected value type; a mismatched type or default yields a 400.

info.name: Get feature-flag state for a user

params.name: user-id
params.description: The Apptimize user (customer) identifier the assignment is scoped to.

params.name: feature-flag-variable-name
params.description: The name of the feature-flag variable defined in Apptimize.

params.name: attributes
params.description: JSON object of custom user attributes used for experiment targeting, passed as query parameters on GET requests.

items.docs: Returns whether the named feature flag is enabled for the given user, honoring the flag's rollout and targeting rules.

info.name: Get all variant assignments for a user

params.name: user-id
params.description: The Apptimize user (customer) identifier the assignment is scoped to.

params.name: attributes
params.description: JSON object of custom user attributes used for experiment targeting, passed as query parameters on GET requests.

items.docs: Returns the full set of experiment and variant assignments currently in effect for the given user.
